title: From Prefix Cache to Fusion RAG Cache: Accelerating LLM Inference in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
selection_reason: Combines precomputed RAG KV caches with selective recomputation to recover cross-chunk context; reports 2.66-9.39x TTFT reduction versus full attention while improving normalized F1 at low recomputation ratios.
